name: B10-0191/2025 (Renew) – Democracy and human rights in Thailand, notably the lese-majesty law and the deportation of Uyghur refugees
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on democracy and human rights in Thailand, notably the lese-majesty law and the deportation of Uyghur refugees
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking Thailand to stop sending Uyghur refugees back to China, where they may face persecution. It wants Thailand to say where the remaining eight refugees are held and to let the United Nations refugee agency see them. It also asks Thailand to scrap its law jailing people for criticising the monarchy, and urges the European Union to review its ties with Thailand and consider sanctions over human rights abuses.

- Thailand is asked to halt forced returns, protect refugees and release information on the eight still held.
- The European Union may review relations with Thailand and consider sanctions on Chinese officials.
- EU countries are urged to offer protection to Uyghur refugees; the Parliament's position is not binding.
